properties.description:
The list of keywords that are associated with the package, if any.

Reserved keywords can be specified that help with categorizing the package in the [Pulumi Registry](/registry/). `category/<name>` and `kind/<type>` are the only reserved keywords at this time, where `<name>` is one of `cloud`, `database`, `infrastructure`, `network`, `utility`, or `vcs`, and `<type>` is either `native` or `component`. If the package is a bridged Terraform provider, don't include a `kind/` label.

A type from another document is referenced as "path#/types/pulumi:type:token", where path is of the form: "/provider/vX.Y.Z/schema.json" or "pulumi.json" or "http[s]://example.com/provider/vX.Y.Z/schema.json" A resource from this document is referenced as "#/resources/pulumi:type:token".
